_comment: Copy this file to local.settings.json and fill in real values. local.settings.json is gitignored.

Values._comment_storage: AzureWebJobsStorage drives both the Functions host's internal storage (timer schedule, queue listener) and our app's queue + blob clients (when the value is a connection string with AccountKey=, Program.cs reuses it; otherwise it falls through to DefaultAzureCredential). For local dev choose ONE: (a) 'UseDevelopmentStorage=true' if running Azurite, or (b) full connection string from the Azure portal → Storage account → Access keys. Do NOT add a separate AzureWebJobsStorage__queueServiceUri / __blobServiceUri key — that conflicts with the connection-string form.
Values._comment_tracking: When AzureWebJobsStorage is a connection string, BlobTrackingService reuses it and TrackingStorageAccountUrl is ignored. When AzureWebJobsStorage uses identity binding (Azure deployment), TrackingStorageAccountUrl is the endpoint hit by DefaultAzureCredential.
Values._comment_deadletter: Storage Queue buffers failed records before they're written to the Dataverse error table. The QueueTrigger listener for DeadLetterProcessor reads from AzureWebJobsStorage, so the queue must live on the SAME storage account as AzureWebJobsStorage points to.
Values._comment_failureblob: When all queue retries are exhausted, one blob per record is archived under errors/yyyy/MM/dd/{invocationId}-{key}.json. Same storage account as the queue + AzureWebJobsStorage.
Values._comment_disable: Set to 'true' to disable the DeadLetterProcessor QueueTrigger function. Use when the queue doesn't exist yet or storage RBAC is being sorted — a failed listener startup otherwise kills the entire host (incl. the TimerTrigger).
Values._comment_appinsights: Optional. When unset the app runs fine and telemetry is discarded. Set it to start seeing traces/dependencies/exceptions in the Application Insights resource. Format: InstrumentationKey=<guid>;IngestionEndpoint=https://<region>.applicationinsights.azure.com/;...
